Contact.metaTitle: Contact and quote | Kefken Wood Decoration
Contact.metaDescription: Reach Kefken Wood Decoration by phone, WhatsApp or the quote form. Add photos and we will get back to you about your job.
Contact.title: Contact and quote
Contact.intro: Tell us briefly about the job and add photos if you have them. We will call you back.
Contact.name: Full name
Contact.phoneHint: Example: 0532 123 45 67 · international numbers with the country code (+49…)
Contact.messageHint: Size, wood type, location — whatever you know.
Contact.photosHint: Up to 5 photos. They are resized on your device before upload.
Contact.photosSelected: {count, plural, one {# photo selected} other {# photos selected}}
Contact.consent: I have read the <link>privacy notice</link> and agree that my details are processed for this quote and transferred to service providers abroad (Cloudflare, Resend, Google).
Contact.successBody: We will review it and call you back on the number you gave.
Contact.successWhatsapp: You can also message us on WhatsApp

errors.EmailInvalid: E-mail looks wrong. Write it like name@example.com or leave it empty.
errors.MessageTooLong: Message is too long. Keep it under 5000 characters.
errors.TooManyPhotos: You can add up to 5 photos. Remove the extra ones.
errors.PhotoType: Only photos can be uploaded. Remove other files.
